title: Efficient — Enchanters' Forge
description: 🪄 Upgrade your enchantments: Adds a block to level them up!
body:
![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/eeNg7E25/images/cca17c874ce0192df1aee8b16ede99731ae3f390.png)

# Upgrade your Enchantments!
The all new Enchanters' Forge is a new way to combine enchantments together: throw a max-level book at the Forge with a Diamond Block, and it'll upgrade to the next level!

Also adds an Enchanters' Forgery - a block to apply enchantments on items. Throw a book at the Forgery to apply it to an item in your hand! (same recipe as above, with anvil instead of enchantment table)

### Supported Enchantments (requests open!):
- Efficiency
- Unbreaking

**To remove the Enchanters' blocks, light them on fire! They will drop as an item :3**

This is a datapack, not a mod or plugin! Be mindful when uninstalling!
